title: Toward Knowledge-Centric AI: Discovering, Internalizing, and Using Explicit Knowledge Across Agents and Generations
title_zh: 迈向以知识为中心的 AI：跨智能体与跨世代的显式知识的发现、内化与使用

paragraphs.en: 提出以知识为中心的AI愿景，主张构建独立于单一智能体的显式知识层，内化是关键瓶颈。 Knowledge is how understanding accumulates across people and generations: durable records that outlive their producers and that others can check, combine, teach, and correct. AI agents are now built and run by many independent users and organizations, and each agent is upgraded, replaced, or retired within months. Yet what an agent learns stays trapped in model parameters, a transient context window, or a system-specific memory store that is appended to and retrieved from rather than processed. We argue that the next generation of AI should be knowledge-centric, built around an explicit, continuously evolving knowledge layer independent of any single agent. In this loop, agents discover knowledge from their environments and trajectories; the layer internalizes it by turning fragmented, heterogeneous records and experience into composable, revisable understanding; and agents across systems and generations use the result and return new outcomes for revision. While discovery and use have advanced rapidly with large language model agents, internalization remains the bottleneck. We argue that internalization should become a persistent object of training and maintenance-centered on condition-preserving conceptualization of events and deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning across noisy, heterogeneous representations (text, tables, graphs, rules, and programs). To power this layer, we call for knowledge foundation models that provide shared neural capacity for knowledge computation, and outline a research agenda showing how an explicit knowledge layer delivers reuse, cost efficiency, auditability, and continuity across agent generations.
paragraphs.zh: 提出以知识为中心的AI愿景，主张构建独立于单一智能体的显式知识层，内化是关键瓶颈。知识是理解如何跨越个人与世代积累的方式：它是持久的记录，其寿命超越创造者，可供他人查验、组合、传授和修正。 如今AI智能体由众多独立的用户和组织构建和运行，每个智能体会在数月内被升级、替换或退役。 然而智能体所学到的内容仍被困在模型参数、短暂的上下文窗口或系统专属的记忆存储中，这些记忆存储只被追加和检索，而不被处理。 我们主张下一代AI应以知识为中心，围绕一个独立于任何单一智能体的、显式且持续演进的知识层来构建。 在这一循环中，智能体从其环境和轨迹中发现知识；知识层通过将碎片化、异构的记录和经验转化为可组合、可修订的理解来对其进行内化；跨系统和跨世代的智能体使用内化的成果，并返回新的结果以供修订。 尽管随着大语言模型智能体的发展，发现和使用已快速进步，内化仍然是瓶颈。 我们主张内化应成为训练与维护的持久对象，其核心是对事件进行保持条件的概念化，以及在含噪、异构的表示（文本、表格、图、规则和程序）之上进行演绎、归纳与溯因推理。 为支撑这一知识层，我们呼吁构建为知识计算提供共享神经能力的知识基础模型，并勾勒出一份研究议程，展示显式知识层如何在智能体的世代更替中带来复用、成本效率、可审计性与连续性。
